newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GIB negotiating unit sale to KBB.
newsitem.headline: GIB negotiating unit sale to KBB.

text.p: Belgian retail group GIB confirmed on Tuesday a newspaper report it was in talks to sell its Sarma department store group to Dutch department store chain Hema, a unit of NV Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer (KBB).

"The impact on the (GIB's) consolidated accounts will be around 200 million Belgian francs ($6 million), essentially due to the exceptional amortization of assets," GIB said in a statement. ($ = 33.46 Belgian Francs)
